caption: CLI Agent
description: An agentic CLI observed by Agent Journal, defined by this extension (since 0.4.0-prototype it does not extend the core ai_agent, whose framework-agent vocabulary does not describe an agentic CLI). product identifies the CLI product and version; name is the product name; version is the CLI version; instance_uid is the native session id; uid is set only when a source reports a stable logical agent identity. Launch settings and source references belong to the run manifest and source_ref, not to this object.
name: cli_agent

version.description: The CLI version, as the source reports it or as the adapter's documented discovery found it.

uid.description: A stable logical agent identity, set only when a source reports one; never the product name or a session id.

instance_uid.description: The native session identifier of this invocation.

product.description: The CLI product and version that produced the observed records.
